If you want to throw money (and not a lot of it) into a passing river, you're right here.
Feb 2025 • Family
This is the worst food I've eaten since I got to Vietnam!!! 
We stayed at this hotel and came to dinner with the kids. 
First of all, as soon as we walked in and walked to our table, there was a waitress behind us yelling very loudly at the other waiter in front. Screaming so hard that her ears were ringing and laughing merrily. 
Secondly, while we were picking out food (and the menu was electronic, so the phone was busy with me), my little kid was bored, I couldn't distract him with cartoons. He took a plastic rack with a picture of the QR code and played it. The "yelling" waitress came up and just ripped that plastic off my baby's hands. She didn't ask me to take it, much less say anything to the child, but just vomited viciously. Okay, I didn't say anything. 
Third, the food we ordered was so terrible that NONE!!!! of the 4 dishes we ordered was edible. I'll explain, they ordered beef and vegetables. The meat was so tough that it was impossible for even me to chew, not like a baby. I tried 5-6 pieces and spat it out. I'm not talking about the baby. Next, vegetable noodles. The noodles were somewhere in the middle of the plate, buried, a lump, just a lump of noodles. I'm guessing it's long-boiled noodles and they haven't even been wetted with water to make them go away. Just left the vegetables on top and served. And that's the dish my kid couldn't eat. Next up is beef with salt and pepper, I think that's the name. They forgot to write that it's not just pepper, it's an atomic bomb. It was impossible to swallow. (If we're from South Korea and we're familiar with spicy food and we eat it perfectly) but this dish is a fiasco! The last one is just boiled rice. They brought just a huge bada of digested rice. 
I called the waiter and asked (in English) to bring in the manager. As it turned out, English was not understood here at all, the girl took out her phone and through an interpreter I reached her. She asked me to taste my meat, she refused, took it and brought me hot meat in a few minutes, exactly the same. I call the waiter again and ask her to try it herself, she refuses and says she will not include this dish in the price. I'm asking for the administration, I get a rejection, he's not there, I'm asking for the cook, also a rejection, he's not there either, I don't know how he left so quickly. I suspect it's not there at all and some janitor is cooking, otherwise I can't explain how TERRIBLE COOKING can be. 
Bottom line: we paid for everything except this beef, although we didn't eat the other one either. No, well, basically, the bottled water was delicious because it was the only water we could swallow.

Does not match its surrounds
Jan 2020 • Family
We are staying at the resort and made the mistake of deciding to eat at the restaurant. It’s actually hard to believe this restaurant is linked to resort as the quality and attitude of staff does not match the rest of the resort.
The food at the pool bar is far better!
The staff are inattentive and spent most of their time eating or on their mobile phones.
The menu is extensive, almost too extensive that it’s hard to imagine anything would be fresh.
We went with rice dishes that came out dry and needed to be doused in soy sauce.
Really disappointed we wasted one of our nights at this restaurant. We do not recommend.

Potentially great venue but very narrow food choice
Dec 2017 • Couples
The location is great - right on the river - but for what is supposed to be part of a 4 star hotel, is seriously lacking in any broad menu choice.

It is clearly designed for predominantly Vietnamese local people - not for international residents of the hotel / condotels.

Constantly full of local Vietnamese eating pretty average Vietnamese food at international hotel prices, accompanied by large quantities of beer.

Staff have no idea about serving of international beverages - wines, cocktails, etc. Takes for ever to maybe get something delivered to the tables - and we don't think this is the fault of the waiters/waitresses on the floor - just how they have been trained and the people they are used to serving.

Definitely needs a big big improvement in both management attitude and staff training!

Nice
Feb 2017 • Couples
If you stay at Champa Hotel or Uma Condotel it's inevitable that you'll be too stuffed or tired to leave the Champa Island complex some nights. The restuarant is within easy strolling distance from both. While we expected the restuarant to have high prices we were pleasantly surprised to find that they weren't too much more expensive than some of the places in Nha Trang proper and the food was always fresh and tasty. 

If there's a crowd of locals at one of the big tables it can be a bit noisy, but that's all part of sucking up the local culture :)
